submission.natural_language_explanation: The positive pole fires on words that name a person's physical body and how it looks: body shape and build (physique, figure, curvy, waist, stocky, slim, muscular, 'build'), body size and weight (weight, weigh-in, pounds, underweight, overweight, 'body' in 'upper body'), fitness and athletic condition (fit, fitness, gym, workout, muscle, strength, athlete, wrestler, boxer), and the grooming-and-display words that present a body (makeup, mascara, glamour, fashion, runway, pageant, bikini, nude, beautiful or attractive said of a person). It is sense-specific and local: the same surface forms in abstract, object or non-human senses - 'the body of the text', 'the figure in the report', an airport runway, 'an early stage', 'a financially attractive offer', a curvy road, the beauty of a painting, sport results and politics - stay near zero, as do neutral prose and long-range topic carry-over.
